column1: # Per-version facts for the version named in .minecraft-version.
# the workflows through them. Columns are separated by whitespace.
#   java      the Java release the server image and Gradle builds run
#   image     the itzg/minecraft-server tag; docker-compose.yml's MC_IMAGE_TAG
#   loader    the server's Fabric loader, exported as FABRIC_LOADER_VERSION;
#             docker-compose.yml's fallback carries the 1.21.1 row's loader
#   accepted  Modrinth game versions a pin may target, best first
